content.text: Section 24 fully matches the preferred position, and no change-of-control right appears elsewhere.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position on every material term: we may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, reorganization, acquisition or substantially-all-assets sale (24.1, notice only); the Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a direct competitor of ours (24.2); other assignments are subject to a mutual reasonable-consent standard (24.3); and 24.4 expressly denies the Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13.x and 30.5 are consistent (licence rights transfer to a permitted successor; successors may enforce). No residual change-of-control or anti-assignment boilerplate elsewhere cuts against us, so no redline is warranted.
